title: What to do After a Minor Car Accident in Gresham
content:
Being in a car accident can be incredibly stressful. If you find yourself in a fender bender in Gresham, OR, the most important thing is to stay calm.

1. Move to a Safe Location

If the vehicles are drivable and there are no serious injuries, pull over to the shoulder or a nearby parking lot to avoid blocking traffic.

2. Check for Injuries

Ensure everyone involved is okay. If there are injuries, call 911 immediately.

3. Exchange Information

Collect the names, contact info, insurance details, and license plate numbers of all drivers involved.

4. Document the Scene

Take pictures of the damage to all vehicles, the surrounding area, and any relevant street signs or signals.

5. Call Tow Guys for Recovery

If your vehicle is not safe to drive, give Tow Guys a call. We offer fast, 24/7 accident recovery towing to our secure storage lot or a repair shop of your choice.
